verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a hosted AI API and chat service. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any opt-out control for telemetry, usage tracking, or data use. Community comments about prompts possibly being used for training only raise concern; they do not show an opt-out exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
